changelog:
Initial release of linkedin-scraper, enabling LinkedIn profile and search results scraping via a user's Chrome browser session.

- Supports scraping single profiles, bulk searches, and company pages using browser automation.
- Requires active LinkedIn login in Chrome and (optionally) integrates with DuckDB for data storage.
- Implements essential rate limiting, random delays, and stealth browsing patterns to minimize detection.
- Extracts structured profile data (name, title, company, education, experience, etc.) as JSON or inserts into DuckDB.
- Includes robust error handling and progress reporting for bulk operations.
- Emphasizes local data storage and safety—never scrapes private profiles or exfiltrates data.
